Halo Under-Table Trap — CFD Report

Potential-flow simulation of the counterflow airfield, CO2 plume, simulated smoke test, and crosswind / wind-tunnel analysis for the Halo 300mm disc trap.

1. Airflow & CO2 Plume

GreenGuard HALO — under-table airflow + CO2 plume
================================================
Grid: 76x76x73 @ 12mm   solver info=0

Operating point
  target throat intake velocity : 1.50 m/s  (3.36 mph)
  louver exit velocity          : 0.82 m/s  (1.83 mph)
  CO2 buoyant settling          : 0.12 m/s (downward)
  implied volume flow           : 10.9 CFM

CO2 concentrator sector (Eco yeast system)
  yeast CO2 output              : 150 ml/min (~500 ml bottle, 24-48 h life)
  sector span                   : 45 deg (6 of 48 louver slots)
  sector exit concentration     : 4308 ppm  (3888 ppm above ambient)
  non-sector louvers            : 420 ppm  (plain air)
  ankle-zone mean CO2           : 883 ppm

CO2 plume (released at louver ring, advected 10s)
  recaptured by throat          : 0.0 %   (CO2 settling > field at ankle depth)
  reaches ankle zone (z=-450mm) : 89.6 %
  median plume descent          : 710 mm below the disc

Interpretation
  - CO2 curtain descends to the floor, pooling at ankle/calf height — exactly
    where Aedes mosquitoes attack seated people.
  - The concentrator sector (~45 deg, 6 Venturi slots) raises the exit
    concentration 3888 ppm above ambient using only a 500 ml yeast
    bottle (sugar + water + yeast, ~$0.10/refill, 24-48 h life).
  - A mosquito tracking the CO2 gradient enters the throat suction zone
    (strong at z=0..-150mm, r<45mm) and is captured by the fan.
  - Zero infrastructure: no tank, no regulator, no refill station.

Vertical cross-section: streamlines (blue), CO2 parcels (amber), ankle zone (dashed).

Mechanical suction capture zone (>50% draw-in within dwell window):
  z=-100mm:  r < 50mm
  z=-200mm:  r < 50mm (effective limit not resolved)
  z=-300mm:  r < 50mm (effective limit not resolved)
  z=-450mm:  r < 50mm (effective limit not resolved)

Interpretation:
  The fan's direct suction zone is compact (r~50mm at 100mm depth) — as
  expected for a 66mm throat. The CO2/scent lure (89% ankle-zone reach)
  is the primary long-range attractant; the suction closes the trap once
  a mosquito enters within ~50mm of the throat centerline.
  Design note: widening the throat or adding a funnel would extend the
  mechanical capture radius.

Left: top-down slice at z=-200mm. Green = captured, red = escaped. Right: capture heat-map by lateral radius and depth.

-------------------------------------------------------

CO2 ankle reach degrades below 50% above ~2.2 mph crosswind.

Note: under a table the free-stream wind is further attenuated
by table legs and table top (~40-60% blockage vs open field).
A 5 mph outdoor wind is roughly 2-3 mph under the table,
maintaining 27-77% ankle-zone CO2 coverage in typical conditions.
